items.title: Charles Schwab, JPMorgan Chase Slide On Vanguard-Backed AI Threat
items.summary: Charles Schwab led a wide swath of brokerage, bank and other financial stocks lower on Tuesday as AI-fueled competition heats up.  Schwab's partnership news with Anthropic last week was meant to address just this kind of disruption, but may have fallen short.  Markets didn't react much on Sept. 1, when Altruist announced its new AI-powered all-in-one financial planning agent, encompassing retirement planning, investment optimization, cash flow analysis, estate planning, tax strategy, and insurance and risk.

items.title: PayPal surges on Meta AI deal as tech rotation sinks financials
items.summary: Investing.com -- Financial sector stocks took a significant hit on Tuesday as investors aggressively rotated capital into the technology space, driven by mounting enthusiasm for Meta’s Muse AI agent. The artificial intelligence frenzy sharply divided the financial landscape: traditional banking and wealth management took the brunt of the selloff, while fintech giant PayPal saw a notable surge following a newly announced integration with Meta. items.title: Stocks, Bonds Climb as Oil Falls on US-Iran Hopes
items.summary: Stocks and bonds kicked off the week on a positive note as hopes for diplomatic efforts to end the war in Iran drove oil prices lower, easing inflation anxiety. The advance in equities erased the S&P 500's decline for the month, with a renewed rally in chipmakers also buoying sentiment. Omar Aguilar, CEO and CIO of Schwab Asset Management, joins for a broad look across asset classes for the rest of 2026.
